reason: The repository is best classified as an external-services integration plugin: it extends DeepSeek Harness by integrating Antigravity CLI/Gemini into the host for LLM subagent delegation, deep web search, and image-to-text support, with diagnostics and setup UI exposed in plugin settings. Evidence from README and package metadata consistently describes a dsh bundle patch/plugin-based extension and external provider/tool wiring, so the primary user-facing purpose is connecting dsh workflows to external AI tooling.

summaries.zh: dsh-llm-agy 是一个 dsh 插件，用于接入 Antigravity CLI，帮助用户在工作流中使用子代理、深度网页检索和文本模型图片读图，并提供连通性诊断面板。
summaries.en: dsh-llm-agy is a dsh plugin that integrates Antigravity CLI, enabling sub-agent delegation, deep web search, and image-to-text support for text models with a connectivity diagnostics settings panel.

capabilities: Invokes and delegates tasks to external Antigravity CLI via dsh LLM adapter integration
Runs web searches through an AGY search provider path that can access remote sources
Adds image-to-text tool flow that stores pasted images and sends paths to AGY/Gemini for reading
Registers extra agent/search/tool capabilities through dsh extension hooks

reasons.code: Plugin claims direct invocation/spawn of AGY CLI for subagent reasoning and model routing, which depends on external executable behavior.
Deep web search feature is implemented through AGY search_web flow and can fetch and summarize external web content.
Image paste workflow persists user images into workspace paths before model processing, introducing local file-write handling.
Manifest and bundle metadata show external integration via dsh client/server plugin entry points and extension registration.
